Name: Performance Color
Expression:

VAR Low = 0.7

VAR Selectedattribute = Round('Measure'[Grade_Average_Standard_Measure],4)

        SWITCH(TRUE(),
        Selectedattribute>=High, "#00FF06", //longitudinal green
        AND(Selectedattribute<Low,Selectedattribute>0), "#FFCCFF",

Return
Result

Name: Treemap Color
Expression:
VAR strand = SELECTEDVALUE(dim_standard[Strand])

-- Get numeric values from the first 3 characters
VAR c1 = UNICODE(LEFT(strand, 1))
VAR c2 = UNICODE(MID(strand, 2, 1))
VAR c3 = UNICODE(MID(strand, 3, 1))

-- Create a pseudo-random number from the characters
VAR hash = c1 * 10000 + c2 * 100 + c3

-- Generate light RGB values (between 200-255)
VAR r = 200 + MOD(hash, 56)
VAR g = 200 + MOD(INT(hash / 1000), 56)
VAR b = 200 + MOD(INT(hash / 1000000), 56)

-- Convert to hex
RETURN
    "#" & 
    RIGHT("0" & FORMAT(r, "X"), 2) &
    RIGHT("0" & FORMAT(g, "X"), 2) &
    RIGHT("0" & FORMAT(b, "X"), 2)

Name: Performance_Color_Standard 3
Expression:
VAR High = 0.8
VAR Low = 0.7

VAR StandardAverage = 
    AVERAGEX(
        SUMMARIZE(
            'cube_question_summary_overall',
            'cube_question_summary_overall'[Standards],
            "Standard_Avg", CALCULATE(AVERAGE('cube_question_summary_overall'[Grade_Average]))
        ),
        [Standard_Avg]
    )

VAR Result = 
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        StandardAverage >= High, "#00FF06",         // Green
        StandardAverage < Low && StandardAverage >= 0, "#FFCCFF", // Pink
        StandardAverage >= Low && StandardAverage < High, "Yellow"
    )

RETURN
Result
